subthemes.name: Generating structures and sequences
subthemes.gist: Using AI to create new molecules, proteins, and complex structures from scratch by learning patterns from existing data, rather than simulating every atom.

subthemes.name: Solving equations and modeling systems
subthemes.gist: Training neural networks to act like mathematical equations to predict how physical systems evolve over time—faster and cheaper than traditional computer simulations.

subthemes.name: Predicting properties and interactions
subthemes.gist: Helping researchers quickly predict what a molecule or drug will do—its toxicity, activity, or how it binds to proteins—without expensive experiments.

subthemes.name: Understanding what AI learned from biology
subthemes.gist: Building foundation models trained on vast amounts of biological data—DNA, proteins, cellular images, brain signals—so researchers can adapt them to new questions.

subthemes.name: Imaging and reconstructing hidden structures
subthemes.gist: Using AI to recover sharp images from blurry scans or partial data, revealing internal structures in microscopy, medical imaging, and cryo-EM without expensive higher-resolution equipment.

subthemes.name: Reasoning about cause and effect
subthemes.gist: Helping AI understand not just correlation but causation—which gene or drug actually causes a disease—through causal inference and interpretable reasoning.

subthemes.name: Forecasting weather and natural phenomena
subthemes.gist: Building AI weather forecasters that blend physics knowledge with data to predict storms, climate, and environmental changes more accurately.

subthemes.name: Decoding brain signals and neural activity
subthemes.gist: Translating brain scans, EEG, and neural recordings into readable signals—what someone is thinking, intending, or perceiving—opening new ways to understand and help the brain.

subthemes.name: Optimizing through simulation and search
subthemes.gist: Using AI to explore enormous design spaces—finding the best drug or molecular design—by combining learning with search and reinforcement learning techniques.
